items.text: A confirmation email is on its way to the address you entered. If it doesn't show up in a few minutes, check your spam folder.
On November 11, at 6 p.m. New York time, we send the Zoom link.
On November 12, the room opens at 6 p.m. New York time. The last minutes are for questions.
After the webinar, the {brand} team contacts you on the WhatsApp number you entered.
Which documents prove the source of my funds?
Where does my money sit in the project, and what happens if construction runs late?
When and under what conditions does my capital come back?
How much will I pay beyond the amount I invest, in USCIS fees and attorney fees?
